name: R-410A — GWP100
note: Assessment set established from our own data rather than an external table: refrigerant blends are defined mass fractions, so solving R-410A (50/50 R-32/R-125) against our R-32 implies R-125 = 3501, the AR4 value. That component set then reproduces our R-407C (1774.1 vs 1774) and R-404A (3922.0 vs 3922). Five of six values are mutually consistent on AR4.

note: Corrected from 1760 to 1810. 1760 is the AR5 value and was the sole outlier in an otherwise AR4 set; the selector label shown to users already read 1810. Assessment set established from our own data rather than an external table: refrigerant blends are defined mass fractions, so solving R-410A (50/50 R-32/R-125) against our R-32 implies R-125 = 3501, the AR4 value. That component set then reproduces our R-407C (1774.1 vs 1774) and R-404A (3922.0 vs 3922). Five of six values are mutually consistent on AR4. This raises reported emissions for R-22 users by 2.84%.
